name: Smart Polymeric Materials
description: This course focuses on the syntheses, structure, behaviour of polymers and polymeric materials that are responsive to external stimuli such as temperature, light, electric potential, pH, and ionic strength. This introduces the concepts of stimuli-responsiveness, including the fundamental materials properties required for their design. The module also gives an overview of the design, preparation and uses of polymers in the area of smart surfaces, polymer brush, membranes, gated transport, intrinsic and extrinsic self-healing, shape memory, redox and pH responsive drug release etc., with a focus on the factors governing their physical properties and their structure-property relationships.
